contents.browser.inspectUri.description:
format to use to rewrite the inspectUri: It's a template string that interpolates keys in `{curlyBraces}`. Available keys are:
 - `url.*` is the parsed address of the berjalan application. untuk instance, `{url.port}`, `{url.hostname}`
 - `port` is the debug port that Chrome is listening on.
 - `browserInspectUri` is the inspector URI on the launched browser
 - `browserInspectUriPath` is the path part of the inspector URI on the launched browser (e.g.: "/devtools/browser/e9ec0098-306e-472a-8133-5e42488929c2").
 - `wsProtocol` is the hinted websocket protocol. This is set to `wss` if the original URL is `https`, atau `ws` otherwise.

You may need to konfigurasikan this if your sourcemaps require authentication atau use a self-signed certificate, untuk instance. contents.customDescriptionGenerator.description:
Customize the textual description the debugger shows untuk objects (local variables, etc...). Samples:
      1. this.toString() // will call toString to print all objects
      2. this.customDescription ? this.customDescription() : defaultValue // Use customDescription method if available, if not return defaultValue
      3. function (def) { return this.customDescription ? this.customDescription() : def } // Use customDescription method if available, if not return defaultValue
contents.customPropertiesGenerator.description:
Customize the properties ditampilkan untuk an object in the debugger (local variables, etc...). Samples:
    1. { ...this, extraProperty: '12345' } // Add an extraProperty 12345 to all objects
    2. this.customProperties ? this.customProperties() : this // Use customProperties method if available, if not use the properties in this (the bawaan properties)
    3. function () { return this.customProperties ? this.customProperties() : this } // Use customDescription method if available, if not return the bawaan properties

    Deprecated: This is a temporary implementation of this feature until we have time to implement it in the way described here: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/102181

contents.node.killBehavior.description:
Mengonfigurasi how debug processes are killed when menghentikan the sesi. Can be:

- forceful (bawaan): forcefully tears down the process tree. Sends SIGKILL on posix, atau `taskkill.exe /F` on jendela.
- polite: gracefully tears down the process tree. It's possible that misbehaving processes continue to jalankan after shutdown in this way. Sends SIGTERM on posix, atau `taskkill.exe` dengan no `/F` (force) flag on jendela.
- none: no termination will happen.
contents.browser.killBehavior.description:
Mengonfigurasi how browser processes are killed when menghentikan the sesi dengan `cleanUp: wholeBrowser`. Can be:

- forceful (bawaan): forcefully tears down the process tree. Sends SIGKILL on posix, atau `taskkill.exe /F` on jendela.
- polite: gracefully tears down the process tree. It's possible that misbehaving processes continue to jalankan after shutdown in this way. Sends SIGTERM on posix, atau `taskkill.exe` dengan no `/F` (force) flag on jendela.
- none: no termination will happen.
